subject: automation-improvement-plan

immediate_improvements.auto_rss_rebuild: cron every hour: rebuild RSS from measurement cards
immediate_improvements.auto_sitemap_rebuild: cron every hour: rebuild sitemap from measurement cards
immediate_improvements.auto_indexnow_submit: cron every hour: submit new URLs to Bing IndexNow
immediate_improvements.auto_quality_gate: cron every hour: check all cards have honest_sentence/kind/subject
immediate_improvements.auto_stablecoin_monitor: cron every6h: fetch stablecoin data, generate cards
immediate_improvements.auto_regulatory_monitor: cron every12h: check open comment windows, generate cards

medium_term_improvements.auto_crosswalk_update: when regulation changes → auto-update crosswalk cards
medium_term_improvements.auto_feed_distribution: Telegram bot, Mastodon bot, Bluesky bot
medium_term_improvements.auto_dune_dashboard: Dune Analytics dashboard for stablecoin measurements

long_term_improvements.fully_autonomous: firehose → card → quality → RSS → sitemap → IndexNow → feed → distribution
long_term_improvements.self_healing: auto-fix broken cards, auto-update stale data
long_term_improvements.self_monetizing: auto-generate x402 paid endpoints from new cards

metrics.significance: From manual cards to fully autonomous24/7 measurement machine

honest_sentence: Automation plan: current32 cron jobs, manual RSS/sitemap. Immediate: auto-rebuild RSS/sitemap hourly, auto-IndexNow, auto-quality gate, auto-stablecoin/regulatory monitor. Medium: ASI-Evolve, auto-crosswalk updates, feed distribution, Dune dashboard. Long: fully autonomous self-healing self-expanding self-monetizing.
